How do I use it properly the very first time?
For the Wax Melt Discovery Starter Kit we discussed, here’s an easy first run with its Mod Wax Warmer:
Set it up: Put the warmer on a level, heat-resistant surface, away from curtains or loose papers. Place the silicone dish on top.
Add wax: Start with 2–3 bears from one scent. Keep the wax below the top of the dish so it can’t overflow.
Start warming: Plug it into a standard outlet. Press the Power Timer button twice for a 3-hour session. You can choose a longer session later if you’d like.
When you’re done: Don’t leave the warmer on while you’re asleep or out of the room. Let the wax cool completely before lifting the silicone dish and popping the wax out to change scents.
That’s it—you’re ready for your first melt!
